name: pov-cat-lights
goal: Board task T11: in the seated first-person view of the first vote, every other real player's cat sits under its own light (60° above the table side, wide soft cone holding the ears), on every process, head at rest / left / right / up; turned off (pov-black-nocatlights) the cats fall back to the plain seated view. Real clients, so the cats really sit at the table. Judge the pov-black-* captures against pov-black-nocatlights-*.
